notes: Step line traced from the NISAR LOS map (median on 3 km blocks): the jump sits at 10.51-10.52 N from about 68.45 W to Moron. Copernicus EMS's Sentinel-1 GRM shows the same ~30 cm step with the opposite sign; the legend was not checked, so the facts say 'sign convention unresolved' rather than claiming agreement. GEER mapped no surface rupture in this frame, so the line is called a step in the radar, not a fault trace.

facts.title: A sharp E-W step in the radar north of Urama and Morón
facts.text: At about 10.51-10.52°N, from 68.45°W east to Morón, NISAR's motion jumps by up to about 30 cm over 1.5-2 km, with a thin low-coherence seam. Copernicus EMS's Sentinel-1 map shows a step of the same size here (its sign convention is not resolved). GEER found no surface rupture in the field in this area.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Copernicus EMS EMSR884 AOI00 GRM https://rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu/backend/EMSR884/AOI00/GRM_PRODUCT/EMSR884_AOI00_GRM_PRODUCT_v2.zip

facts.title: North of the step, the coastal plain moved ~20 cm toward
facts.text: On the Boca de Aroa / Tucacas side, the coastal plain moved about +22 cm along NISAR's line of sight (16 to 33 cm). About half of it is measured. At Boca de Aroa sand and water boiled up through cracks during the shaking.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | GEER-087 https://geerassociation.org/?view=geerreports&id=117 (Boca de Aroa ejecta, StEER media)

facts.title: South of the step, Urama to Morón moved ~17 cm away
facts.text: South of the step, from Urama to Morón, the ground moved about 17 cm away from the satellite (10 to 25 cm), and most of it is measured.

facts.title: Morón: 8 buildings destroyed, 39 damaged, on the step
facts.text: Copernicus EMS mapped 8 destroyed and 39 damaged buildings in Morón from satellite images; in Las Colinas de Morón 16 houses fell and two women were killed. The damage sits right where NISAR's motion jumps, from about -28 to -6 cm within this area.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Copernicus EMS EMSR884 AOI06 https://rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu/backend/EMSR884/AOI06/GRA_MONIT01/EMSR884_AOI06_GRA_MONIT01_v2.zip; Diario de Los Andes https://diariodelosandes.com/carabobo-16-viviendas-colapsaron-en-las-colinas-de-moron-y-250-familias-siguen-sin-volver-a-sus-casas/

facts.title: Pueblo Farriar: a 380 m crack along the river bank
facts.text: At Pueblo Farriar a fissure about 380 m long opened within 3 m of the river channel: the bank spread toward the river, not a fault offset. NISAR sees smooth ground here, about +3 cm, with almost no step within 1 km.

facts.title: San Felipe barely moved, yet 13 homes were wrecked
facts.text: San Felipe moved only about 2.5 cm in NISAR's view, 45 km from the step. Thirteen homes were still heavily damaged there: shaking, not ground displacement, did it.
